svg.text: Fixed lunch break vs. dynamic rest (initial schedule over the same worlds)

svg.text: Fixed lunch = 12:00–13:00 unavailable for everyone; dynamic rest = search for a zero-disturbance gap of ≥ 30 min between 180 and 240 cumulative work minutes

svg.text: The harness uses an idle-gap proxy for dynamic rest. The live implementation additionally re-validates route feasibility and successor windows, so “rest slot found” here is an upper bound.
